payload.description_html: Juvenile fishes of  Mugilidae. The Mugilidae are a family of salt and brackish water fish. These fish feed on algae,mainly diatoms, planktonic organisms and debris. They inhabit coastal waters, more or less deep, reaching lagoons and river mouths. Specimens that feed in fresh or brackish water grow faster than others.
